name: Be a Rocket
desc:
🚀 BE your ROCKET and race to the END!

How To Play
💵 BE a Rocket to get RICH!
🏢 BUILD a tall skyscraper to launch FARTHER!
🚀 UPGRADE your rocket to increase SPEED!
🪐 TRAVEL to new planets for rare TOWERS!
😀 VISIT your friends buildings and RACE them!

New Update:
📦 CRATES! Unlock brand new tower SKINS!
🚀 TRAILS! Customize your ROCKET!

👍 Make sure to LIKE and FAVORITE for more updates!
